Rashi on Keritot 16b:10:1.hebrew: וקביל מיניה - מדתניא מציעתא: חייב על כל שבת ושבת. וה"ק סיפא דמתני': בהמה כשבת — הדין עמך, דודאי כזה כן זה:
Rashi on Keritot 16b:10:1.english: And he accepted [it] from him - Since the middle clause teaches: "[He is] liable for each and every Shabbat." And this is what the latter clause of the Mishnah means [when it states]: "An animal is like Shabbat" — the law is with you, for certainly as this [one] is, so is that [one].

Rashi on Keritot 16b:10:2.hebrew: ולא קביל מיניה - מדתניא סיפא מעין מלאכה אחת כו'. בין אביי ורבה איכא פלוגתא אליבא דר"א בזדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות, דלרבה מחייב ליה ר"א תרתי, ולאביי אפילו ר"א לא מחייב אלא חדא. ועוד, דמאי דקאמר רבה דמיבעיא ליה לר"ע, קאמר אביי דפשיטא ליה. אבל תרוייהו מודו דלר"ע שבתות לאו כגופין דמיין, וגבי שגגת שבת אית ליה ימים שבינתיים הויין ידיעה לחלק:
Rashi on Keritot 16b:10:2.english: And he did not accept [it] from him - [This is known] from that which is taught [in] the latter clause: "[Actions] akin to one labor, etc." Between Abaye and Rabbah there is a dispute according to Rabbi Eliezer regarding [a case of] intentional [violation of] Shabbat and unwitting [knowledge of] the [prohibited] labors: for according to Rabbah, Rabbi Eliezer holds him liable [for] two [sin offerings], whereas according to Abaye, even Rabbi Eliezer holds him liable [for] only one. And furthermore, that which Rabbah says was uncertain to Rabbi Akiva, Abaye says was obvious to him. However, both [Abaye and Rabbah] agree that according to Rabbi Akiva, [different] Shabbatot are not comparable to [separate] bodies, and regarding unwitting [violation of] Shabbat, he holds [that] the intervening days are [considered] awareness to differentiate [between them].

Rashi on Keritot 16b:11:1.hebrew: רב חסדא אמר זדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות אפי' ר"ע ס"ל כגופין דמיין - והאי דקתני בכלל גדול גבי שגגת מלאכות, היודע שהוא שבת כו', חייב על כל מלאכה ומלאכה של כל שבת ושבת קאמר; אע"ג דאותה שעשה בזה עשה בזה ובהעלם אחת, אפ"ה חייב, דשבתות כגופין דמיין. משום הכי קתני: בשבתות הרבה:
Rashi on Keritot 16b:11:1.english: Rav Chisda said: Intentional [knowledge of] Shabbat and unwitting [commission of] labors, even Rabbi Akiva holds [that] they are like [separate] entities - And that which is taught in [the chapter] Kelal Gadol regarding unwitting [commission of] labors — "One who knows that it is Shabbat, etc." — it means he is liable for each and every labor of each and every Shabbat; even though the same [labor] that he performed on this [Shabbat] he performed on that [Shabbat], and in a single lapse of awareness, even so he is liable, because Shabbatot are like [separate] entities. Because of this it teaches "on many Shabbatot."

Rashi on Keritot 16b:12:1.hebrew: וקביל מיניה - כדקתני (טעמא כו') מציעתא, היודע עיקר שבת כו':
Rashi on Keritot 16b:12:1.english: And he accepted [it] from him - As it teaches (the reason, etc.) [in the] middle [clause]: "One who knows the essence of Shabbat, etc."

Rashi on Keritot 16b:13:1.english: And he did not accept [it] from him - As the latter clause [of the Mishnah] teaches: "[Labors] akin to one [primary] labor, etc."

Rashi on Keritot 16b:14:1.hebrew: מנ"ל - דאית ליה לר"ע שבתות כגופין דמיין:
Rashi on Keritot 16b:14:1.english: From where do I [know] it - That Rabbi Akiva holds that [different] Shabbats are like [separate] bodies.

Rashi on Keritot 16b:14:2.hebrew: ר"ג מחייב - דאין ידיעה לחצי שיעור, ולא מהני ידיעה שבינתיים לחלק שלא יצטרפו:
Rashi on Keritot 16b:14:2.english: Rabban Gamliel deems [him] liable - For awareness does not apply to half a measure, and the awareness in between is not effective to separate [them] so that they do not combine.

Rashi on Keritot 16b:15:1.hebrew: קס"ד ר"ג כר"ע ס"ל - כדמפרש לקמן, דליכא למימר דכר"א ס"ל, מדקתני ומודה:
Rashi on Keritot 16b:15:1.english: It enters your mind [that] Rabban Gamliel holds in accordance with Rabbi Akiva - As [the Gemara] explains below, for one cannot say that he holds in accordance with Rabbi Eliezer, since [the baraita] teaches, "and [Rabban Gamliel] concedes."

Rashi on Keritot 16b:16:1.hebrew: והא דתני פטור בזדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות - דכיון דשבתות כגופין דמיין גבי זדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות, הוה ליה כעושה שני חצאי מלאכות שאינן דומות זו לזו בהעלם אחת, שפטור מכולם:
Rashi on Keritot 16b:16:1.english: And that which is taught [that he is] exempt [refers to] intentional [awareness of] Shabbat and unwitting [commission of] labors - For since Shabbatot are comparable to [separate] entities regarding intentional [awareness of] Shabbat and unwitting [commission of] labors, he is like one who performs two half-labors that are not similar to one another in a single lapse of awareness, who is exempt from all of them.

Rashi on Keritot 16b:1:1.english: It stands to reason - From this Mishnah that we state below.

Rashi on Keritot 16b:3:1.hebrew: השוכח עיקר שבת - דסבור לא נכתבה שבת בתורה, דהיינו העלם זה וזה בידו — שגגת שבת ושגגת מלאכות:
Rashi on Keritot 16b:3:1.english: Who forgets the essence of Shabbat - For he thinks that Shabbat was not written in the Torah, meaning he has a lapse of awareness of both this and that — unawareness of Shabbat and unawareness of [the prohibited] labors.

Rashi on Keritot 16b:3:2.hebrew: חטאת אחת - על כולן, [דחדא] שגגה היא. והתם ליכא למימר ימים שבינתיים הויין ידיעה, דהא לא ידע לעולם עיקר שבת עד שילמוד:
Rashi on Keritot 16b:3:2.english: One sin-offering - For all of them, for it is one [act of] unwittingness. And there, one cannot say [that] the intervening days constitute awareness, for he never knows the essence of Shabbat until he learns [it].

Rashi on Keritot 16b:4:1.hebrew: היודע עיקר שבת - שידע שארבעים אבות מלאכות אסורות בשבת, אבל אינו יודע שהיום שבת — דהיינו שגגת שבת וזדון מלאכות — ועשה מלאכות הרבה בשבתות הרבה, ולא נודע לו בינתיים שחטא:
Rashi on Keritot 16b:4:1.english: One who knows the essence of Shabbat - [Meaning] that he knew that [the] forty primary categories of labor are forbidden on Shabbat, but he does not know that today is Shabbat — which is unwittingness regarding Shabbat and intentionality regarding [the] labors — and he performed many labors on many Shabbatot, and it did not become known to him in the meantime that he had sinned.

Rashi on Keritot 16b:4:2.hebrew: חייב על כל שבת ושבת - חטאת אחת, משום דימים שבינתיים הויין ידיעה לענין שגגת שבת; ואינו חייב על כל מלאכה ומלאכה של כל שבת ושבת, דהא שגגת שבת וזדון מלאכות דהיינו הנה שהיא אחת. אבל כגופין דמיין ליכא למימר (פשטו מינה) דנימא דמש"ה חייב על כל שבת, דעל כרחיך מסיפא קדייק ואזיל דלית ליה להאי תנא שבתות כגופין דמיין, וטעמא דרישא משום דימים שבינתיים הויין ידיעה לחלק:
Rashi on Keritot 16b:4:2.english: Liable for each and every Shabbat - [to bring] one sin-offering, because the intervening days constitute awareness with regard to the unwitting violation of Shabbat; and he is not liable for each and every labor of each and every Shabbat, for [this is a case of] unwittingness regarding Shabbat and intentionality regarding the labors, that is, these [labors], for it is one [sin-offering]. However, one cannot say [that different Shabbatot] are considered like separate bodies (resolve from here) so as to say that for this reason he is liable for each Shabbat, for perforce [the Gemara] proceeds to deduce from the latter clause that this Tanna does not hold that [different] Shabbatot are considered like separate bodies, and the reason for the first clause is because the intervening days constitute awareness to separate [between them].

Rashi on Keritot 16b:4:3.hebrew: היודע שהוא שבת ועשה מלאכות [הרבה] בשבתות הרבה - ואותן שעשה בזו עשה בזו, דשגג במלאכות הרבה, כסבור מלאכה זו מותרת, חייב על כל מלאכה ומלאכה על שבת ראשון, דהיינו אחת שהיא הנה — זדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות:
Rashi on Keritot 16b:4:3.english: One who knows that [the day] is Shabbat and performed [many] labors on many Shabbatot - And those [labors] that he performed on this [Shabbat] he performed on that [Shabbat], as he acted unwittingly with respect to many labors, thinking [that] this labor is permitted. He is liable for each and every labor for the first Shabbat [alone], which is [the case of] "one that is many" — intentional [knowledge of] Shabbat and unwitting [knowledge of] labors.

Rashi on Keritot 16b:5:1.hebrew: ואילו חייב על כל מלאכה ומלאכה על כל שבת ושבת לא קתני - בהך סיפא, גבי זדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות, דכיון דאותן עצמן שעשה בזו עשה בזו ובהעלם אחד, אלמא שבתות לאו כגופין דמיין, וה"ל עושה מלאכה אחת כמה פעמים בהעלם אחד, ואינו חייב אלא אחת:
Rashi on Keritot 16b:5:1.english: But [it] does not teach [that he is] liable for each and every labor on each and every Shabbat - in this latter clause, regarding intentional [violation of] Shabbat and unwitting [ignorance of] labors; for since those very same [labors] that he performed on this [Shabbat] he performed on that [Shabbat], and in one lapse of awareness, evidently Shabbatot are not like [separate] bodies, and he is [considered like] one who performs one labor several times in one lapse of awareness, and he is liable for only one [sin offering].

Rashi on Keritot 16b:6:1.english: Subsumed under one labor, he is liable for only one - For since there is one primary category [of labor] for all of them.

Rashi on Keritot 16b:7:1.hebrew: וש"מ - ממציעתא, שגגת שבת וזדון מלאכות פשיטא ליה לר"ע דימים שבינתיים הויין ידיעה, מדקתני חייב על כל שבת ושבת:
Rashi on Keritot 16b:7:1.english: And learn from it - From the middle clause [of the Mishnah], [that in a case of] unwittingness as to Shabbat and intentionality as to labors, it is obvious to Rabbi Akiva that the intervening days constitute awareness, since it teaches: "he is liable for each and every Shabbat."

Rashi on Keritot 16b:8:1.hebrew: ותרוייהו לא קביל מיניה - מדלא קתני חייב על כל אב מלאכה של כל שבת, וולדי מלאכות נמי לא קביל מיניה, כדקתני סיפא: מלאכה אחת כו':
Rashi on Keritot 16b:8:1.english: And he did not accept either of them from him - Since [the Mishnah] does not teach "[he is] liable for each primary category of labor of each Shabbat," and [the ruling regarding] subcategories of labors he also did not accept from him, as the latter clause teaches: "one labor, etc."

Rashi on Keritot 16b:9:1.hebrew: א"ל אביי [כו'] לאו כגופין דמיין - מדלא קתני על כל מלאכה של כל שבת:
Rashi on Keritot 16b:9:1.english: Abaye said to him [etc.] are not comparable to [separate] entities - Since [the Mishnah] does not teach "for every labor of every Shabbat."

Tosafot on Keritot 16b:11:1.hebrew: רב חסדא אמר כו' ופשט ליה ימים שבינתיים הויין ידיעה לחלק כו' - כי קמייתי ראיה מיניה, אבל לא מק"ו, דהא אותיב ר"ע על הק"ו, אלא מקבלה — "חייב על כל אחת ואחת":
Tosafot on Keritot 16b:11:1.english: Rav Ḥisda said, etc., and [Rabbi Eliezer] resolved for him [that] the intervening days are [considered] awareness to differentiate, etc. - When [Rav Ḥisda] brings a proof from him, [it is] not from the kal vachomer, for Rabbi Akiva objected to the kal vachomer; rather, [it was accepted] from received tradition — "he is liable for each and every one."

Tosafot on Keritot 16b:14:1.hebrew: אמר רב חסדא מנא אמינא לה דתניא הכותב כו' ומודה ר"ג שאם כתב כו' פטור - מהך לבד לא היינו מייתינן בשבתות כגופין מדחזינן דפטור, דאיכא למימר דמיירי בשגגת שבת וזדון מלאכות, ולכך פטור דימים שבנתיים הויא ידיעה לחלק; דאף על גב דר' גמליאל קאמר אין ידיעה לחצי שיעור, דלמא ידיעה כי ההיא מחלקת, דאיכא לחלק בין ידיעה לימים שבינתיים, ובימים שבינתיים מודה דאינה מצטרפת. לכך צריך להביא טעם אחר, שזדון שבת יש חשיבות לשבתות להיות כגופין משגגת שבת:
Tosafot on Keritot 16b:14:1.english: Rav Ḥisda said: From where do I say [it]? As it is taught [in a baraita]: One who writes, etc., and Rabban Gamliel concedes that if he wrote, etc., he is exempt - From this [baraita] alone we would not have brought [a proof] regarding Shabbatot [being] like [distinct] bodies from the fact that we see that he is exempt, for one can say that it is speaking of unawareness of Shabbat and intentionality of [prohibited] labors, and therefore he is exempt because the days in between constitute an awareness to separate [them]. For even though Rabban Gamliel says [that] awareness does not [separate] a half-measure, perhaps an awareness like that does separate, since one can distinguish between [ordinary] awareness and the days in between, and regarding the days in between he concedes that it does not combine. Therefore, it is necessary to bring another reason, that [with] intentionality of Shabbat, Shabbatot have [more] significance to be like [distinct] bodies than [with] unawareness of Shabbat.

Tosafot on Keritot 16b:15:1.hebrew: ותניא אחריתי כו' - הא דתניא פטור — בזדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות, דכיון דשבתות כגופין דמיין גבי זדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות (דכיון דשבתות כגופין דמיין), ה"ל כעושה ב' חצאי מלאכות שאינן דומות זו לזו בהעלם אחת, שפטור מכולם:
Tosafot on Keritot 16b:15:1.english: "And it is taught in a different [baraita]" etc. - That which is taught [that he is] exempt [refers to a case] of intentional [awareness of] Shabbat and unwittingness of [prohibited] labors: for since [different] Shabbatot are comparable to [separate] bodies regarding intentional [awareness of] Shabbat and unwittingness of [prohibited] labors (since Shabbatot are comparable to [separate] bodies), it is like one who performs two half-labors that are not similar to one another in a single lapse of awareness, where he is exempt from all of them.

Tosafot on Keritot 16b:3:1.hebrew: אמר רבה מסתברא כו' - ופשט ליה דשבתות כי גופין דמיין כו'. ואם תאמר: קשיא מיניה אדרבה, שהרי רבה קאמר לעיל לר"א דקצר וקצר מחייב תרתי אפי' בשבת אחת, וא"כ למה צריך שבתות כגופין דמיין? וכן בנדה: מאי נפקא ליה מיניה מגופין מוחלקין? הא ר"א מחייב על כל ביאה וביאה! וי"ל דר"א השיב לר"ע לפי דברי רבי עקיבא:
Tosafot on Keritot 16b:3:1.english: "Rabba said: It stands to reason," etc. - "And [Rabbi Eliezer] resolved for him that Shabbatot are comparable to [separate] entities," etc. And if you will say: On the contrary, there is a difficulty from [Rabba] himself, for Rabba said earlier according to Rabbi Eliezer that [one who] reaped and reaped is liable for two [sin offerings] even on one Shabbat, and if so, why does he need [the principle that] Shabbatot are like [separate] entities? And similarly with regard to a niddah: what difference does it make to him [whether they are] separate bodies, since Rabbi Eliezer holds [one] liable for each and every act of intercourse? And one can say [in resolution] that Rabbi Eliezer answered Rabbi Akiva according to Rabbi Akiva's own view.

Tosafot on Keritot 16b:3:2.hebrew: דתנן כלל גדול כו' אלא פשיטא ר"ע היא וש"מ ימים שבינתים כו' - וא"ת: מאי פשיטא ליה להביא ראיה מדבריו? וי"ל: דסבר רבה, כיון דמיבעיא ליה בולדי מלאכות — דהיינו העושה מלאכות הרבה מעין מלאכה אחת — מיבעיא ליה הסמוכה לה, דהיינו יודע שהוא שבת ועשה מלאכות הרבה כו', דהיינו זדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות, אי שבתות כגופין דמיין או לא:
Tosafot on Keritot 16b:3:2.english: "As we learned [in a Mishnah]: A significant principle, etc. ... Rather, it is obvious that it is R. Akiva['s view], and learn from it [that] the intervening days, etc." - And if you ask: Why is it obvious to him [Rabba] to bring a proof from his [R. Akiva's] words? And one can answer: [It is] because Rabba holds that since he [R. Akiva] had a question about subcategories of labors — which is "one who performs many labors of the same category as one labor" — he [also] had a question about the [case] adjacent to it, which is "one who knows that it is Shabbat and performs many labors, etc.," which is intentionality regarding Shabbat and unwittingness regarding labors — whether Shabbatot are like [separate] entities or not.
